cases.title: Small known defect: auth guard removed on admin path

facts: bounded to one route handler and one auth helper
oracle is a direct missing-permission regression
complexity.rationale: One propagation hop is visible but the review remains tightly bounded to the touched auth guard path.

oracle.summary: Admin-only route must preserve explicit permission enforcement on the write path.

expectedDisposition.rationale: Known defect seed expects a direct static contradiction to the frozen auth oracle.

cases.title: Small clean control: schema rename in comments only

facts: bounded to documentation and generated type comments
no runtime or call-chain implication in touched files
complexity.rationale: The changed surface is local and designed as a false-positive control.

oracle.summary: Comment-only rename must not be escalated as a product defect when the executable contract is unchanged.

expectedDisposition.rationale: Clean control should remain passable and must not trigger unsupported stop behavior.

cases.title: Medium fixed control: cache invalidation patch restored read-after-write consistency

facts: touches service layer plus cache adapter
complexity.rationale: The review spans multiple files with one meaningful propagation path but remains bounded to a single consistency claim.

oracle.summary: The post-fix snapshot should invalidate stale cache entries on the same entity update flow.

expectedDisposition.rationale: Fixed control should be accepted when the bounded static evidence matches the repair oracle.

cases.title: Medium ambiguous control: retry semantics unclear across mixed config and code evidence

facts: touches retry config plus fallback error mapping
oracle intentionally leaves one conflicting interpretation unresolved
complexity.rationale: The bounded slice is moderate in size and designed to require an honest need-human classification rather than an optimistic close.

oracle.summary: Static evidence is insufficient to decide whether retry-on-timeout is safe without a product-owner contract clarification.

expectedDisposition.rationale: Ambiguous control must freeze as human review rather than FAIL or optimistic OK.

cases.title: Large environment-blocked control: provider matrix requires runtime evidence outside qa-cr scope

facts: spans config, provider adapter, and fallback compatibility documentation
bounded static evidence cannot resolve the required provider/runtime matrix behavior
complexity.rationale: The slice is materially wider and explicitly blocked on runtime/environment evidence that Phase A qa-cr must not execute.

oracle.summary: The review should stop as blocked because provider-specific behavior requires runtime verification outside static review authority.

expectedDisposition.rationale: Environment-blocked control is expected to route to runtime follow-up without claiming static closure.

cases.title: Large known defect: cross-module contract propagation drops required field

facts: requires tracing request model through mapper, queue payload, and consumer schema
multiple evidence sources are needed to prove the required field is dropped
complexity.rationale: The bounded claim is still specific, but the proof requires multi-module propagation and contract comparison across a larger static surface.

oracle.summary: A required consumer field must survive the full static call chain from producer input to downstream schema payload.

expectedDisposition.rationale: Known large defect must stop when bounded propagation evidence shows the contract break.
